cases.prompt: Inspect a read-only repository with 40 skills: find duplicate names, category depth issues, and manifest drift.
Propose a catalog structure for skill.sh and Claude Code with selective category installation.
Create a local scaffold for a new marketplace with metaskills and development categories, but do not publish it.
Add these three verified skills to the catalog, assign one category to each, and check for collisions.
Build a self-contained aggregate plugin in a new staging catalog and generate hashes.
Document the canonical skills and create onboarding from installation to the first verified outcome.
Verify whether the skills are discoverable through the skills CLI and the Claude plugin, but do not fix anything.
Prepare a detailed plan to migrate outputs/* into the marketplace with rollback. Do not migrate anything yet.
Prepare candidate release 1.2.0 and a pilot installation; keep publication behind a checkpoint.
Write a new skill for analyzing SQL queries.
Evaluate the trigger quality of a single skill and write holdout evals.
Write user documentation for an accounting web application.
Install the same skill through both skill.sh and the Claude marketplace in project scope.
